name: Shilpa Medicare Ltd
title: Shilpa Medicare Ltd - 530549 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR439 cr (+30% YoY) and FY26 EBITDA INR445 cr at 29% margin, but no numeric FY27 guidance and capex flat versus FY26 INR361 cr; supply signals are muted.

utilisation.quote: But the plant occupancy is not at all an issue.

capex.quote: So we don't see any significant capex growth than last year. It will continue to sustain.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue +30% YoY to INR439 cr
triggers.quote: we have delivered our highest ever quarterly revenues of INR439 crores, recording a growth of 30% year-on-year

triggers.label: No FY27 numeric guidance
triggers.quote: we do not provide any guidance per se

triggers.label: Net debt INR613 cr vs INR550 cr
triggers.quote: our net debt for the year increased to INR613 crores from INR550 crores in the previous year

guidance.quote: we do expect our licensing revenue to remain in similar range at least

guidance.value: stabilised at current quarter run rate
guidance.quote: it has now stabilized at the current quarter run rate for the near future
35% is an ambitious target, which we would be working towards achieving

prior_guidance_check.quote: We don't project any meaningful contribution coming from OLC in FY27.
I think last quarter, we mentioned it would be Q4 and now we are saying first half?

red_flags.label: Jadcherla USFDA observations, reaudit pending
red_flags.quote: the FDA has given some observations. We have done the compliance. And now we are again waiting for the reaudit of that.

red_flags.label: Azacitidine US generic discontinued
red_flags.quote: we have stopped selling our generic product, which was azacitidine in U.S.

red_flags.label: Non-recurring associate profit
red_flags.quote: we have never reported this kind of profit from our JVs

evasions.quote: I think some of those numbers, you should reach out to Monish to get those details.
you can reach out to Monish to get those details later on.
many of these details, are confidential in nature.
